importantNote: Fixed Android lock screen duration & playback progress bar timer, and restored 3-dot options menu buttons across all playlists.

changelog.category: Lock Screen Controller & Playlist Options Fixes (v1.6.7)
items: Synchronized track duration and elapsed position with Android MediaSessionCompat & PlaybackStateCompat.
Fixed lock screen progress bar timer so seconds now count and animate continuously while screen is locked.
Fixed custom playlist track row flexbox layout so 3-dot options buttons are 100% visible on all mobile viewports.
Synchronized Capacitor native assets and updated service worker cache to v105.
